description: État des ascenseurs dans les gares et stations d'Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données liste l'ensemble des ascenseurs disponibles dans les gares et stations d'Île-de-France. Chaque ascenseur est présent sur une zone de correspondance du référentiel des arrêts d'Île-de-France. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Transports en commun, Accessibilité, Gare. The portal shows 944 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-10-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Mobilité (https://cloud.fabmob.io/s/eYWWJBdM3fQiFNm). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
